issue_context.title: inject() returns undefined if called before ready()
issue_context.body:
<!--
Before you submit an issue we recommend you visit [Fastify Help](https://github.com/fastify/help) and ask any questions you have or mention any problems you've had getting started with Fastify.

**Please read this entire template before posting any issue. If you ignore these instructions
and post an issue here that does not follow the instructions, your issue might be closed,
locked, and assigned the `missing discussion` label.**
-->

## 🐛 Bug Report

fastify.inject() returns undefined if called before ready, causing subsequent chai to fail with unhelpful error

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

```js
const server = fastify();

await server.inject().get("...").end();
```

## Expected behavior

inject() returns a valid object even if called before ready().
if it is not possible, throw an error explaining that ready() must be called first

## Your Environment

- *node version*: 12
- *fastify version*: >=2.15
- *os*: Mac
comments: I think this should be fixed on master.

> The issue happens for the chaining usage
> 
> ```
> const fastify = require('./fastify')()
> 
> ;(async function () {
>   fastify.get('/', async () => 'hello')
>   const res = await fastify.inject().get('/').end()
>   console.log(res.payload)
> })()
> ```
> 
> As a workaround, till a fix, the usage of the options works
> 
> ```
> const res = await fastify.inject('/')
> ```

hi @Eomm, I run above this example, it's no problem, the question have solved ?
I didn't work on it: it could be useful if someone could send a PR with a test to avoid regression 👍
@Eomm, the pr  https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/2257 solve it, and the test unit add too.
